profile.headline: Senior Software Engineer at Definitive Healthcare

positions.title: Sr. BI Developer
positions.description:
- Developed data visualizations using d3 and Google Maps APIs.
- Developed Tableau dashboards for business users using Tableau Desktop and the Tableau JS API to aid in WCAG compliance.
- Generated monthly client reports from Tableau dashboards using tabcmd.
- Managed Tableau Server site content and permissions as site adminstrator.

positions.title: SAT & ACT Teacher & Tutor
positions.description: Teach Kaplan approaches to the SAT in one-on-one and group settings.

positions.title: BI Architect/Developer
positions.description:
- Developed Tableau dashboards for business users using Tableau Desktop, R, and the Tableau JS API to aid in WCAG compliance.
- Managed Tableau Server site content and permissions as site adminstrator.

positions.title: Sr. Associate, Technology Development Program
positions.description:
Rotation 1 (06/15-12/15) - Java Application Developer: Integrated web services with existing code to allow users from multiple platforms.

Rotation 2 (12/15-06/16) - Business Intelligence Developer
- Created reports in Cognos Query and Report Studio
- Created alerts for MicroStrategy reports
- Created dashboards in Kibana and Tableau

positions.title: Fellow
positions.description:
Triple Helix website: http://www.3helix.rpi.edu

Moving Professor Ron Eglash’s pCSDTs (programmable culturally situated design tools, http://www.ccd.rpi.edu/eglash/csdt) from Java to Javascript. Building an application to view Charles Darwin and his theories in the context of abolitionism. Also worked in Hackett Middle School's Science on Patrol to show examples of computer forensics. Currently at Albany High School teaching math, science, and computer science through cultural phenomena.

positions.title: Intern
positions.description: Worked on RebateHero (http://www.rebatehero.com). Paired to provide capability to feature rebates for a range of dates instead of single days and add priorities to featured rebates. Also wrote migrations to change rebate categories.

positions.title: Intern
positions.description: Did Ruby on Rails development for the Women's Worlds in Qajar Iran (WWQI) website (http://www.qajarwomen.org/en/index.html).

positions.title: AA&D Training Materials Coordinator
positions.description: Updated and ordered training materials for classes.

positions.title: Intern
positions.description: Compiled the wordlists (English, French, and Spanish) for Swamp Talk, an iOS game, by writing several small scripts using UNIX commands. Also did some QA testing.

positions.title: Residency Assistant
positions.description: Helped graduate students during their stay on campus prior to graduation in June 2008, 2009, 2010, and 2011.

positions.title: Intern
positions.description: Worked on the company Intranet and product suggestion blog.  Used the following tools - TortoiseSVN, BeyondCompare3, Visual Studio 2008, Reflector, SQL Server Express 2008, SQL Server Management Studio 2008, Duplicate Finder v3.5.3, Log4Net, IIS, BlogEngine.NET, and Firebug.

volunteerExperiences.description: Led one-on-one literacy lessons with adults using a modified Wilson curriculum.
Helped a high school senior apply to college and scholarships.

projects.title: Decision Trees
projects.description: Given a training dataset, the algorithm builds a decision tree and classifies a test dataset. I used entropy as a measure of information gain to decide where the optimal split point was.

projects.title: Spectral Clustering
projects.description: Given a dataset, cluster it into 20 clusters using spectral clustering. This particular approach uses k-means clustering as a subroutine. The k-means algorithm is run several times to minimize the sum of squared errors (SSE), and the resultant spectral clustering's normalized mutual information (NMI) measure is calculated.
